labels.title: The Value Proposition Canvas
labels.valueProposition: Service Desk Platform & In-App Vue Widget
labels.customerSegment: App Users, Host Devs & Support Agents

customerJobs.title: Report Bugs In-Workflow
customerJobs.note: File issues from the current Vue page without leaving the app.

customerJobs.title: Onboard Apps Fast
customerJobs.note: Add support intake to a new app without rebuilding forms.

customerJobs.title: Triage Multi-App Tickets
customerJobs.note: Reproduce and resolve tickets from many apps in one workspace.

pains.title: Manual Context Entry
pains.note: Reporters retype URL, screen size and steps taken.

pains.title: Secondary Login Friction
pains.note: A separate helpdesk account just to track a ticket.

pains.title: Hardcoded .env Routing
pains.note: Stream IDs in config files force a deploy per new app.

pains.title: Cannot Reproduce Loops
pains.note: Missing errors and API payloads cause back-and-forth.

gains.title: 1-Click Context Filing
gains.note: Route, viewport and screenshot attach automatically.

gains.title: Self-Service Registry
gains.note: Map apps to streams from an admin page, no deploy.

gains.title: High-Fidelity Diagnostics
gains.note: Last 20 API calls, request IDs and Vue errors per ticket.

gains.title: Single Multi-App Inbox
gains.note: One feed with origin badges and a per-app filter.

productsAndServices.title: In-App Vue Widget
productsAndServices.note: Help panel capturing router state, API calls and screenshots.

productsAndServices.title: Service Desk Hub
productsAndServices.note: Agent inbox for widget, IMAP email and public form tickets.

productsAndServices.title: Admin App Registry
productsAndServices.note: support_widget_apps table and admin page for app-to-stream mapping.

painRelievers.title: Auto Context & Error Capture
painRelievers.note: Captures route, viewport, locale and unhandled exceptions.

painRelievers.title: Sanctum Session, Zero Seats
painRelievers.note: Host app auth identifies reporters; no agent seat needed.

painRelievers.title: Server-Side PII Redaction
painRelievers.note: Strips auth headers, cookies and API keys before saving.

gainCreators.title: Central App-Stream Map
gainCreators.note: Tickets route by app_id from the database at request time.

gainCreators.title: Unified Diagnostics Schema
gainCreators.note: Versioned pack (schema_version 1) attached to every ticket.

gainCreators.title: Origin Badges & Filter
gainCreators.note: client_app chips and multi-select filter isolate each queue.
